args.stdin:
WITH vars AS (
  SELECT 'Heco' AS brand, 'Heco Zinc Plated' AS series, 'HECO 3DW-64B' AS model, 'Nut Bolt and Washer' AS product_name, 'bolt' AS fastener_type, '10 mm' AS diameter
)
SELECT json_object('product_sku', pv.product_sku, 'record_path', pv.record_path, 'product_name', pv.product_name) AS result
FROM product_variants pv
JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = (SELECT fastener_type FROM vars)
JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp2.property_value_text = (SELECT diameter FROM vars)
WHERE pv.brand = (SELECT brand FROM vars) AND pv.series = (SELECT series FROM vars) AND pv.model = (SELECT model FROM vars) AND pv.product_name = (SELECT product_name FROM vars)
UNION ALL
SELECT json_object('product_sku', NULL, 'record_path', NULL, 'product_name', (SELECT product_name FROM vars))
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM product_variants pv
  JOIN product_variant_properties pvp1 ON pv.product_sku = pvp1.product_sku AND pvp1.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND pvp1.property_value_text = (SELECT fastener_type FROM vars)
  JOIN product_variant_properties pvp2 ON pv.product_sku = pvp2.product_sku AND pvp2.property_key = 'diameter' AND pvp2.property_value_text = (SELECT diameter FROM vars)
  WHERE pv.brand = (SELECT brand FROM vars) AND pv.series = (SELECT series FROM vars) AND pv.model = (SELECT model FROM vars) AND pv.product_name = (SELECT product_name FROM vars)
);
